nameEn: Treatment and disposal of non-hazardous waste
description: This class includes the treatment and disposal of non-hazardous waste.
includes: operation and use of disposal sites for non-hazardous waste
treatment of non-hazardous waste for disposal: incineration, composting, other methods
operation of landfill sites for non-hazardous waste
disposal of non-hazardous waste by incineration or combustion
production of compost from organic waste
excludes: treatment and disposal of hazardous waste, see 3822
incineration with energy recovery, classified in appropriate energy generation class
